data.name: Vampires of the 99th Night
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the night shift. In Vampires of the 99th Night, you play as a charmingly bloodthirsty vampire on a quest to survive an endless horde of demons, skeletons, and monster invaders. This is a fast-paced action-roguelite where your reflexes will be tested, the floors will be painted red, and every death is just an excuse to make your castle even deadlier.

Hack, Slash, and... Snack?

Dive into tight, visceral, top-down combat. Dash through foggy forests and cursed dungeons, leaving a massive trail of pixel-art carnage in your wake. But survival requires strategy. When a peasant is in trouble, you face a tactical choice: will you show mercy and rescue them, or sink your fangs in to restore your own HP?

Build Your Dark Domain

You won't survive all 99 nights on your first try. Luckily, vampires play the long game. Collect Blood Coins during your runs and spend them in the metaprogression builder. Construct Throne Rooms, Gates, Dungeons, Kitchens, Libraries, Towers and more in your castle to unlock powerful passive buffs that will give you the edge on your next night out.

Master the Rituals

Take a breather from the bloodshed with quirky, high-stakes minigames and random encounters scattered throughout your run:
  • The Tesla Gambit: Test your reflexes and dodge deadly bolts of lightning.
  • A Game of Fate: Keep your eye on the prize in the skull-shuffling shell game.
  • The Perfect Pour: Steady your hand in the blood-pouring minigame to score discounts.
  • Bone Smashing: Break the grid to uncover hidden loot and crowns.
  • ...and more minigames that will be revealed as you progress.

Features:

  • Addictive Roguelite Loop: Live, die, upgrade your castle, and try again.
  • Spooky-Cute Aesthetics: Gorgeous, moody pixel art mixed with over-the-top, satisfying gore.
  • Deep Customization: Level up your max HP/MP, negotiate the purchase of new weapons from shady merchants, and tailor your build to your playstyle.
  • 99 Nights of Escalation: The enemies get tougher, the fog gets thicker, and the action gets faster.

Will you conquer the 99th night, or just become another stain on the dungeon floor?

data.short_description: You are a cute vampire. There will be blood. Survive a grueling 99-night gauntlet of fast-paced hack-and-slash action, expand your dark domain, and decide who lives and who becomes your next meal. Death is inevitable, but your castle is eternal. Can you make it to the 99th night?
